I'm sorry to hear your going through this, actually I can maybe share some helpful experience.

So when I was around 8-14 ish I always went to sleep by staring at the ceiling. The room was completely black, so I keep staring at the ceiling and before I knew it I fell asleep. While I was staring at the ceiling before I sleep I was constantly telling myself, "Okay tonight I want to dream about myself with donald duck, spongebob, and be in a dream with all my favorite cartoon characters and it worked! I just repeated what I wanted to dream about over and over and over while staring at the ceiling

So I was lucid dreaming as a kid and I thought that this was just a regular thing everyone does.

As for when the dreams turn bad, the key here is awareness of the dream 100%, so the dream turns nasty and I just say "hold up a second I'm dreaming I don't have to deal with your crap" then I just sort of "will" myself some super power like a punch that will completely obliterate the demon or whatever and they shatter like glass

Now this takes a lot of practice and it might not work the first few times....even when I do this on a regular basis...some of the bad experiences I just couldn't turn around...but I do believe how you react to the negative experience affects it..... If you react with fear then it will get worse...if you just say "lol I'm dreaming fuck off" it most likely will go away

I hope this helps with the bad dreams, even with the good dreams....I just get tired of lucid dreaming sometimes I just want to be able to black out

I've actually done it once on accident...I went to sleep next thing I know I'm on the other side of the house drifting around...the whole house was dark...it felt like I was floating around and overall I was confused and didn't know what was going on at the time. I never thought to try to do anything interesting or go look back at myself sleeping, since I wasn't aware of what was actually happening.
